body:
Adds `research/kelly-markets`, which closes the Kelly/wealth-dynamics item left open in `wagering-modular-experts`.

- Heterogeneous-λ clearing: the price is the λ·wealth-weighted mean belief and total wealth is conserved. λ=1 reproduces the Bayes mixture.
- Regret bound `ln(1/s)/λ` for any sequence, adversarial included. It is loose on i.i.d. data.
- Growth-optimal fraction `(π−p)/(q−p)`.
- Manipulation cost `V·χ²(p₀‖p)`, compared with LMSR `b·KL`.
- Switching-truth experiment: full Kelly is wrong about half of each segment, and λ of about 0.1–0.2 cuts regret 3–7×.

11 tests pass. `README.md` and `docs/index.html` are updated.
